title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11
source: Partial Set 3; 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-Recorded by Bear (Reel # 4 Only); 1st Generation Cassettes(TDK SA-X 100's) Transferred By Dick Latvala; (Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer (Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise); Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing (iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard excerpt with crystal‑clear audio and a stellar Love Light performance, but only a short fragment of the concert is available.
ai_review.review: The recording captures about thirty minutes of a 1970 show with superb sound quality – reviewers rave about its clarity and the band’s inspired playing. Jerry’s feedback solo around the 18‑minute mark is highlighted as a standout moment, though fans are left wanting the missing Dark Star > St. Stephen segment and the rest of the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise the audio fidelity and musical performance (average star rating ~3.8, with four 5‑star comments). The strong recording quality and enthusiastic band playing outweigh the disappointment of an incomplete show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix; reviewers describe the sound as ‘excellent sq’ despite the excerpt being short. No notable drop‑outs or muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a ~30‑minute snippet is present, featuring an energetic Love Light segment with strong transitions; reviewers note the missing remainder of the concert (Dark Star > St. Stephen and beyond) as a major loss.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Feedback solo around 18:00 highlighted as a highlight.
